label: Salt Flats
note: Issue #615: the salt crew's course, a fast loop across the salt pan below their village, its start/finish line on the straight down the west side, about 300 m from the village. It runs through a range of three tunnel peaks (course_mountains salt_flats in content/look/desert_landforms.json: the tunnel is cut along this course's own legs from c5 back to c2, so it bends a little at c3 and c4, with runner lights along the walls): c1 lines you up on the tunnel, c2 is its west portal, c3 and c4 inside, c5 the east portal; then you drop off the playa's edge into the deep basin north of it (c6, c7), climb out up its west side (c8) and come back down the valleys to the start (c9, c10). Same shape as hoodoo_run.json (read its note: the course is straight legs between the gates); no track beast here.
